description: Screenshot of four consecutive tweets by Rep. Jim Jordan (@Jim_Jordan), each posing a rhetorical 'Why did @AdamSchiff...' question about Rep. Adam Schiff's conduct regarding Michael Cohen's testimony, Glenn Simpson, Bruce Ohr, Chris Steele, and the Steele Dossier. The tweets present Jordan's accusations as questions; the claims are his characterizations, not established facts.
text: Rep. Jim Jordan @Jim_Jordan · 21m. Why did @AdamSchiff say that his talks with Michael Cohen were limited to inviting him and allaying any concerns about threats to his family—but NOT mention the 14 hours his staff spent prepping Cohen BEFORE the hearing?. 390 1.0K 2.3K. Rep. Jim Jordan @Jim_Jordan · 1h. Why did @AdamSchiff fail to disclose that he met with Glenn Simpson (whose Dossier oppo research was funded by the Clinton campaign) in Aspen?. 539 2.0K 4.2K. Rep. Jim Jordan @Jim_Jordan · 2h. Why did @AdamSchiff falsely claim in his memo that Bruce Ohr HADN'T communicated his relationship with Chris Steele to the FBI prior to the 2016 election?. 913 3.7K 8.0K. Rep. Jim Jordan @Jim_Jordan · 2h. Why did @AdamSchiff try to block Congress from learning that the Clinton campaign paid for the Dossier?. 1.9K 5.8K 13K.
flags: Tweets contain unverified accusations framed as questions

description: Screenshot (CNN-formatted image, per filename and edge watermark) of a tweet by @The_Trump_Train that Donald J. Trump retweeted. The tweet is a photoshopped meme showing Obama-era officials and Democratic figures behind prison bars, including Robert Mueller, John Podesta, Barack Obama, Hillary Clinton, Huma Abedin, James Clapper, Bill Clinton, and Loretta Lynch, with a caption asserting that 'Russia collusion' is a proven lie and asking when treason trials begin. The image is a composite, and its claim is the meme's assertion, not fact.
text: Donald J. Trump Retweeted. The Trump Train @The_Trump_Train · 9h. NOW THAT RUSSIA COLLUSION IS A PROVEN LIE, WHEN DO THE TRIALS FOR TREASON BEGIN?. 5.0K 8.4K 24K. TWITTER.
flags: Meme's 'proven lie'/treason claims are unverified assertions
Composite/photoshopped image, not a real photograph
Some additional figures behind bars not identified with certainty

description: Screenshot of Q drop #3005 (tripcode !!mG7VJxZNCI, dated 9 Mar 2019) as displayed on a Q aggregator site. The drop embeds a screenshot of Donald Trump's 4 Mar 2017 tweet claiming Obama had his 'wires tapped' in Trump Tower, and adds the line 'The President of the United States told you who authorized the targeting.' Both the tweet's wiretap claim and Q's assertion are unverified claims carried by the archive.
